$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Normative companion of docs/prep/gi-format.md (GI version 1). The document defines the text syntax; this schema defines the header model a reader records after reading it.
title: GI version 1 header, as read
description: The annotations of a GI file (Goliath-intermediate G-code) as a reader records them: one object per header annotation, the operations, and the GI line each came from. Lengths are millimetres. Unknown keywords and keys are not in the model: the reader warns about them (N-GI-UNKNOWN-KEY) and ignores them. Values that a header line omits are absent, never defaulted.

version.description: From the version line ';GOLIATH-GI 1' on line 1. Any other version is refused (D-GI-VERSION) and produces no model.

ops.description: The OP ... OPEND blocks in file order. Empty when the file has none (operations are then inferred by later stages and disclosed).

line.description: 1-based line number in the GI file, counted like .NET File.ReadAllLines (CRLF, CR or LF).

length.description: A length in millimetres, greater than zero.

text.description: Free text: a quoted string or a bare token in the GI line. UTF-8 is allowed (it is inside a comment). Reports escape it before display.

source.description: ;GOLIATH SOURCE: which CAM program and post wrote the file. Provenance only.

units.description: ;GOLIATH UNITS: the unit of every length in the file. GI 1 knows millimetres only; any other value is refused (D-UNITS).

stock.description: ;GOLIATH STOCK: the panel the program was written for. x, y, t, origin and zzero must agree with job.toml; a disagreement is refused naming both (D-GI-CONFLICT).

origin.description: Where X = 0, Y = 0 is: t1-corner, the stock corner where tower 1 stands, with the stock in [0, x] x [0, y] (spec 08, Coordinate frame and inputs).

zzero.description: Where Z = 0 is: top (the stock top, cuts are negative; spec 05) or bottom (the stock bottom).

tower2.description: ;GOLIATH TOWER2: the axis tower 2 stands on, seen from tower 1. Y puts tower 2 at the corner (0, H); X at (W, 0) (spec 08, spec 02 SET T2 POSITION).

tool.description: ;GOLIATH TOOL: the one tool of the program. Every value job.toml also declares must agree with it (D-GI-CONFLICT).

n.description: Tool number; T words and OP tool= must name it.

rpm.description: Spindle speed in revolutions per minute.

zshift.description: ;GOLIATH ZSHIFT: the Z shift the post has already applied to every Z in the file. Informational: recorded, never applied by the reader.

applied.description: Always false: the reader never applies ZSHIFT (red-team PHYS-12). A model with true is invalid.

through.description: GI through=auto, 1 or 0 as "auto", true or false. A hint: the geometry decides, and a contradicted flag is a warning of a later stage.

c.description: Forced heading in C units (spec 08): the only candidate for this operation's cuts, still fully checked. 360 is the same heading as 0.
